diagnosis: The generic `grind` call fails only in the `app` constructor’s special `old(fvar ...)` branch: the match introduces equalities after the initial simplification, so they are not rewritten before automation. Explicitly splitting that match and its identifier test, then rerunning `simp_all`, resolves the branch while leaving the routine recursive cases to `grind`.
proof_body:
by
  induction post <;>
    simp_all [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
  case app =>
    split
    · split <;>
        simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
    · grind
  all_goals grind
